content: OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628) is the accepted pattern for TV/limited-input sign-in: device shows a short user_code plus a verification_uri, optionally rendered as a QR code to avoid manual URL entry; the user authorises on a phone while the device polls the token endpoint. Google, Auth0 and Curius guidance all recommend rendering the verification URI as a QR to improve UX on a 10-foot interface. Kodi itself ships no device-flow helper; the community modules Add-on:OAuth_Helper and Add-on:Oauth2client exist but do not cover device flow. In the Kodi cloud-drive family (cguZZman) the pattern is already implemented as a custom WindowXMLDialog (pin-dialog.xml) with an image control for the QR, a textbox for instructions, and a Cancel button, driven by a QRDialogProgress class that generates the PNG with pyqrcode into the addon profile dir and calls setImage. Proven feasible in Kodi.
